**Build is clean.** Exit 0, "build finished in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors."

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump's shape change:

- [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) threw on `undefined` flags since the new config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`. Added an `undefined` case treating it as disabled.

The rest was just deprecation-warning noise from the version bump, not actionable.

Next: nothing. Build passes, both real bugs fixed.
